scope: Proposition 6.8 (Frozen diffusion law) of the manuscript “A dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for subgaussian log-concave measures” (preprints/A-dimension-free-logarithmic-Sobolev-inequality-for-subgaussian-log-concave-measures-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 093 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 767a5eb7cd819af7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Yu be the stationary diffusion with invariant law η and driving Brownian motion Bu, and fix t > 0. Make the matrix construction of Lemma 6.6 at Y0, using an independent random block offset. In its orthonormal frame put N = Bt/ √ t; conditionally on the initial data and block offset, N is a standard Gaussian vector. Define, in the initial spatial coordinates, σ = ⨁ β β2 exp (√ 8t H[N] − 4tIdβ ) , (6.24) and set σ = 0 on the omitted kernel. Then E∥R(Yt) − σ1/2 ∥2 HS −→ 0. (6.25) The matrices defining σ obey the bounded-column and input-map bounds (6.11) and (6.18), the weighted defects (6.17), and the mixed moment law of Lemma 6.7.
